consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the standout performance of the show is the version of 'Playin' in the Band,' which is described as one of the best ever. Many reviewers also praise Jerry Garcia's guitar work throughout the concert, noting a strong and engaging performance overall.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 41 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While the performance quality is praised, some reviewers found the overall show to be inconsistent, leading to a mixed sentiment despite the high points.
